en-US: Redesign mind map color palettes with adaptive contrast, and flatten the theme picker into a clean list.
Keep flowchart palettes from reverting to forest green after save or reopen.
Let desktop auto-restart even when the connected instance is behind, and show a quiet, platform-specific hint instead of holding the update.
zh-CN: 重做思维导图配色并按对比度自适应文字，主题选择改为干净的扁平列表。
避免流程图配色在保存或重新打开后变回森绿。
即使云端实例落后，桌面端也会自动重启更新；系统信息改为安静提示，并按 Cloudflare 或 Docker 给出对应更新方式。
